text: Fine fabrics for fine captains! And for you, too.
Darling, those clothes. What happened? A shipwreck? Two?
{npc}, clothier. Sailor's slops to captain's coats, and dye for every colour of the sea.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
A good coat, a better hat, and boots that don't mind seawater. The rest is personality.
The captain's coat says 'I own the ship'. The bayou oilskins say 'I own a swamp'. Choose wisely.
The sailor's set takes any dye. Mix them at a crafting table, or bring them to me and buy the dye here.
Reinforcing kits, from the armorers. Stitch iron into the lining and the coat stops a cutlass. Mostly.
